Security guarantees for the warring sides are set to top the agenda, with US officials insisting that a broader security architecture for Europe must be part of any peace deal.

title: US Defense Secretary Hegseth faces expected impeachment vote this week

title: KSrelief project to provide safe water to 200,000 Rohingya in Bangladesh
description: A new program funded by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center aims to provide safe water and hygiene to over 200,000 Rohingya refugees in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. The $2.5 million project, in cooperation with the UN's International Organization for Migration, will enhance water and sanitation infrastructure over 12 months, addressing critical needs in a region hosting around 1.3 million Rohingya fleeing violence in Myanmar.
